2.question: Where is IKHWA INVESTMENTS located?

3.question: Who legally represents 'IKHWA INVESTMENTS BY IKHWA NETWORK'?

firstPart.description: Companies are divided according to the nature of their work into civil companies and commercial companies. Commercial companies are further divided according to their basis on personal or financial considerations into partnerships, capital companies, and companies of mixed nature. Only commercial companies acquire merchant status, bear the obligations arising from this status, and are subject to bankruptcy laws when they stop paying their commercial debts. Civil companies can take one of the forms specific to commercial companies, such as being established as a partnership, limited partnership, limited partnership with shares, joint stock company, or limited liability company. In this file, we provide you with details on establishing a limited liability company in the Kingdom of Morocco.
features: Processing registration procedures for the articles of incorporation and domiciliation.
Commercial registry readiness within two weeks.
Conducting comprehensive feasibility studies for company operations.

secondPart.title: General
secondPart.description: A limited liability company, abbreviated as LLC in the Kingdom of Morocco. In some countries it is abbreviated as Ltd. In French: SOCIÉTÉ À RESPONSABILITÉ LIMITÉE SARL, which means: a company consisting of two or more persons, where the partner's liability for its debts, obligations, and losses is limited to the amount of their share in its capital. The partner's share is transferred upon death to their heirs or those they recommend for any share. The number of partners in this company does not exceed fifty partners.

stepsSection.title: Steps we follow to establish a limited liability company

1.title: Obtaining a negative certificate
1.description: This is the first step in establishing a company in Morocco, which involves obtaining a negative certificate that confirms that there is no similar name to the proposed company name within two months. This certificate is valid for six months.

2.title: Working on the domiciliation or lease contract
2.description: Lease contract, domiciliation contract, property ownership, or proof of building purchase where the main objective is to clarify the company's address and prove the company's right to use the property for commercial activities.

3.title: Establishing the company's articles of association
3.description: Establishing the articles of association specific to a limited liability company in Morocco, obtaining partner signatures, defining the scope of work, and determining capital and shares for each partner.

4.title: Opening a bank account with capital deposit
4.description: Opening a temporary bank account to deposit capital, and upon completion of company establishment procedures, the temporary bank account is converted to a regular company account.

5.title: Registration for property tax and tax identifier
5.description: Registration for property tax and obtaining the company's tax identifier, which is necessary to begin the company's legal and financial activities.

6.title: Required documents for establishing a limited liability company in Morocco
6.description: Collecting all required documents according to Moroccan law to ensure smooth establishment process in compliance with legal requirements.

7.title: Registration in the commercial registry
7.description: The company is registered in the commercial registry, which is the official record that legally proves the company's existence and gives it the right to conduct commercial activities.

8.title: Affiliation with the National Social Security Fund in Morocco
8.description: Registering the company and employees with the National Social Security Fund to ensure social protection and compliance with Moroccan labor laws.

9.title: Official forms
9.description: Preparing and printing all official company forms such as the official seal, correspondence, and all necessary documents to start operations.

yourRights.intro: When it comes to your personal data, the law preserves a number of rights for you. You can obtain more information and advice about your rights from the data protection authority in your country, and your rights include:
rights: Right to object to data handling: You have the right to object to certain types of data processing, including processing for the purpose of direct marketing (if you no longer wish to receive messages about potential opportunities, for example)

Right to be informed: You have the right to obtain clear, transparent, and easy-to-understand information about how we use your information and your rights. This is why we provide you with information in this policy

Right to access your information: You have the right to access your information (if we are processing it) and certain other information (similar to the information contained in this privacy policy), to view and verify that we use your personal data in compliance with data protection law
Right to correct information: You have the right to correct your information if it is inaccurate or incomplete

Right to delete information: Also known as 'the right to be forgotten', in other words, you may request the deletion or removal of your information when there is no compelling reason for us to continue using it. This right is not a general right and there are exceptions

Right to restrict data handling: You have the right to 'block' or be strict with the use of your information for an additional period. When blocking the handling of your information, we can continue to store it on the condition that we do not use it again. We keep lists of individuals who have requested to 'stop' the handling of their information to ensure we respect their request in the future

Right to data portability: You have the right to obtain your personal data and reuse it for your own purposes in different activities. If you decide to switch, for example, to a new provider, this right allows you to transfer your information, or copy or convert it without trouble from our systems to their IT systems safely and without negatively affecting the possibility of using it
Right to file a complaint: You have the right to file a complaint with the relevant data protection authority in your country about the way we handle or process your personal information
yourRights.exercise: You can exercise any of the rights mentioned above by submitting a request to the email: contact@ikhwainvestments.com.
yourRights.limitations: The Company may not be able to allow access to all personal data stored with it in certain circumstances, when disclosure, for example, leads to the disclosure of confidential business information, or if the personal information is subject to a confidentiality condition between the customer and the lawyer, or if that information was collected during an investigation into a contractual breach or legal violation.

complaints.title: How Can I Object to Compliance and Make Suggestions?
complaints.content:
You can direct your questions or inquiries to the email contact@ikhwainvestments.com about the privacy principles mentioned above or about the privacy practices applied by the Company and contained in the privacy policy.

The Company will investigate all complaints and answer all the questions you raise. If it turns out that the complaint is based on a basis, the Company will take appropriate measures to settle it, which may extend to amending its policies and procedures.

yourRole.title: Your Role in Protecting Your Personal Data
yourRole.content:
Please remember that the privacy policy of IKHWA Investments Company and the use of your personal data applies only to the information provided by you. We would like to warn you when you disclose personal information, or sensitive privacy data while you use chat rooms or newsgroups, or bulletin boards or other public forums online, that the collection of that information is not done by or on behalf of the Company, but may be collected and used by other people or companies over which the Company has no authority. The Company is not responsible for privacy data or privacy compliance, or for any other content that appears on any website that is not owned and operated by the Company or its allied companies.

We would like to emphasize that the Company makes every effort to protect and safeguard personal information, and we advise that there are protective measures that you must follow as well. We recommend that you do not share your personal information with any third party unless you are clearly aware of the purpose of their request, and are aware of who you are dealing with. Do not keep sensitive personal information in your email inbox or on webmail.

updates.title: Updating This Privacy Policy
updates.content: The Company will update this privacy policy to add any changes to our practices, and to comply with applicable laws, and the Company may amend or remove parts of this privacy policy whenever it deems it necessary to do so. When we make any changes to this privacy policy, we will notify you. You can check the last update of this privacy policy by referring to the date shown at the top of the first page.
